description: This file defines a Java class `UpdateNoteCommandHandler` responsible for handling update note commands within the Fineract project. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface and delegates the actual update operation to the `NoteWritePlatformService`. It is annotated as a Spring `@Service` and its `processCommand` method is transactional.

classes.name: UpdateNoteCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed service class that processes update note commands by delegating to `NoteWritePlatformService`.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update a note, marked with `@Transactional`, and delegates to `writePlatformService.updateNote`.

methods.name: UpdateNoteCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the note write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles updating a note using the provided command object.
